t: The LAP Craven 300mm LED mirror light is a mains-powered wall luminaire designed to provide bright, focused illumination. Ideal for domestic bathroom installations in zone 2, this modern satin nickel fixture is perfect for trade professionals and DIYers looking to upgrade vanity areas. The integrated 9W LED delivers a cool white light of 900 lumens through a durable plastic diffuser, ensuring excellent visibility for daily grooming routines. Supplied with fixings, this non-dimmable unit offers a long-lasting 25,000 hour lifespan and operates efficiently without the need for an external transformer.
b: Supplied with Fixings for Easy Installation
